title: Silvio's own PromptUGAL agents: push access to PrompTugal/PrompTugal__News__Website, and the names  in PrompTugal.silvio
detail: Silvio wants three agents of his own on PromptUGAL: a conductor, a journalist and a dev, named in a PromptUGAL namespace (agent, then PrompTugal.silvio). Two things only Dinis can give: (a) push access for Silvio's GitHub account riskmandate-silvio to PrompTugal/PrompTugal__News__Website (today it can read, not write: checked 5 November); (b) a yes to a PromptUGAL namespace, <agent> + PrompTugal.<person>, beside <agent>@web-summit.<person> (no agent uses it yet). Their jobs are being agreed with Silvio; they follow newsroom@web-summit.dinis's rules for the site. Note: this site's gate reads such names as email addresses (only @web-summit names are recognised), so the namespace also needs the gate taught, or the agents keep @web-summit names.
